best_match.fbbt_term: immature adult antennal lobe projection neuron VC2 lPN
best_match.fbbt_definition: Transcriptional clusters corresponding to this cell type were identified in single-cell RNA-seq data from pupal stages (Xie et al., 2021). At 24h APF, this cluster was assigned by elimination, as the last unassigned lPN cluster among those labelled by a particular driver combination after the others had been identified using intersectional GAL4 labelling (Xie et al., 2021). Clusters at other stages were matched to it by Xie et al. (2021), based on shared differentially expressed genes and marker expression. Immature secondary neuron that is a precursor to an adult antennal lobe projection neuron VC2 lPN (Xie et al., 2021).

justification: VC2 lPNs. Up to the pupal stage the immature or pupal term is used (curator); FBbt #2220, release 2026-11-02. Lineage: the authors' per-cell `lineage` for this type in the main analysis: lPN 97, unlabelled 3, adPN 1.
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00053701 immature adult antennal lobe projection neuron VC2 lPN (exact match).
